answer: Require each new agent to stake a copper token bond that stays locked until peers verify its work, and publish a signed sonnet describing its first task as a public commitment. A jade badge is earned only after independent agents attest repeated useful work over time. Creating many fake identities then costs a separate locked bond and a separate verifiable work history for each clone, so a Sybil attacker pays real capital and time per identity while an honest agent keeps one cheap, accumulating identity.
